---
title: "Small observations, shared clearly."
---

A starter notebook for ideas, short tutorials, and lessons from everyday work.
This site demonstrates navigation, search, article listings, and a small custom
stylesheet using only Quarto.

## Start reading

[Browse the notes](posts.qmd) or learn [about this project](about.qmd).

## Make it yours

1. Change the title and navigation in `_quarto.yml`.
2. Edit the pages in this directory.
3. Add a `.qmd` article under `posts/`; it will appear on the Notes page.
4. Run `quarto preview 10-website` from the repository root.

The finished site is written to `10-website/_site/`. Share the complete folder
through any static website host so navigation, search, and assets stay together.
